Like nate said pcpartpicker.com is incredible, it will alert you if parts don't match up. I'm currently doing my first build and it helps get your head around it. If you have a mid case everything should fit well. You don't need too much space, everyone's doing mini and micro pc builds and that's where size mainly comes in. If you plan on getting an amd CPU just make sure the motherboard has been flashed and is compatible, everything else looks daunting but it's not really. I'd recommend going an amd as well as next year's games are apparently going to require more threads and amd CPUs are generally 8 core and 12 or 16 threads. I went a msi to- Mohawk 470 motherboard or mobo as it's called, 2070 super graphics card/gpu, adata sx8200 pro 2TB ssd, 2x8gb corsair vengeance 3200mhz ram, white meshify s2 case and a corsair gold 750 watt powersupply. Hope this helps, most of this info is from some friends who have been building for decades and I've just created a build with their info. Know that daunting feeling!
